transmitter_grouping.title: Control Mode
transmitter_grouping.description: Should the buttons be created as individual entities or grouped as states in one entity?

menu_option_descriptions.transmitter_grouping_single: A separate object is created for each button of the selected channel. Each object represents one of the up to 4 available button codes (A,B,C,D).
menu_option_descriptions.transmitter_grouping_group: One object is created for all buttons of the selected channel. Each of the up to 4 available button codes (A,B,C,D) represents a state of this object.

transmitter_operating_type.title: Operating Mode
transmitter_operating_type.description: Which operating mode would you like to use?

menu_option_descriptions.transmitter_op_1: Each button on a transmitter can trigger a function. Each button of a channel is assigned a separate object or state.
menu_option_descriptions.transmitter_op_2: Two adjacent buttons of a channel are assigned a function (ON/OFF or UP/DOWN). A separate object is created for each function.
menu_option_descriptions.transmitter_op_3: All 3 or 4 buttons of a channel are automatically assigned to a single object in '3-button operation' mode. This object has 3 states: UP/STOP/DOWN.

transmitter_switch_mode.title: Behavior
transmitter_switch_mode.description: Should the switch state be reset after activation or remain permanent?

menu_option_descriptions.transmitter_switch_impulse: The switch state of an object is reset 1 second after releasing the respective transmitter button.
menu_option_descriptions.transmitter_switch_permanent: The switch state of individual objects toggles with each press of the respective transmitter button.

transmitter_usage.title: States
transmitter_usage.description: How should this 2-button transmitter be used?

menu_option_descriptions.transmitter_usage_switch: Create an ON/OFF state sensor (A = On, B = Off).
menu_option_descriptions.transmitter_usage_cover: Create an Open/Closed binary sensor (A = Open, B = Closed).
